# Frozen evaluation

`preregistration.json` was committed to disk before the local pilot. It hashes
all ten4+3+3 cards, source bytes, signed envelopes, rights ledger, trust registry
and settings/seeds. A changed file fails `PREREGISTRATION_DRIFT`; do not edit a
frozen card to fit an observed result. New inputs require a new cohort.

Arms A/B/C have the same input contract and4096 input/2048 output-token,
zero-LM-native-call and120-second budgets. Their order is randomized with
seed1729. A is a direct LLM, B the same model plus Bridge, C an independent
human source-preserving control. No authorized paired model runs, model ID,
blind evaluator or author receipts were available: **all arms are NOT_TESTED**.
The deterministic local fixture controller is reported separately and is
never labeled an LLM or human baseline. API spend and LLM calls are zero.

Eight cards reference synthetic fixtures; two image/practical cards are
proposals awaiting prior author wording, source and rights. All ten lack real
author confirmation. Local checks retain mandatory declaration counts,
R/T/O losses, explicit refusals, counterexamples, hashes and measured process
costs. Human recognition, blind correctness and paired advantage remain null.
Small sample size and missing arms prohibit a superiority or originality claim.
